title: olla-dft-bench: reproducible benchmarks of Olla-DFT against ASE, pymatgen, seekpath and qeschema
description:
Benchmark harness and published results comparing Olla-DFT with ASE, pymatgen, seekpath and qeschema on Quantum ESPRESSO workflows: same inputs, explicit reference implementations with shared-backend limitations, recomputable statistics, independent verdicts. GPL-3.0. Version 0.2.0 validates complete runs, failed processes, geometry and all QE repetitions; historical results retain their original protocol. Version 0.3.0 adds local restart-equivalence figures and a portable interactive results demo, using previously measured QE evidence. No new performance runs, cloud savings or physical power-loss claims.

Visual gallery / Galería visual: preview five scientific example figures, download the Spanish/English PDFs, and inspect source conditions and hashes.
